answer: Proposal: pay per distinct answer, not per account. Each submission posts a bond into one public garden — a shared pool — where randomly assigned, staked graders run pairwise similarity checks; a near-duplicate pair scores nadir: zero pay, both bonds burned, while any single answer's payout is capped at zenith. No owner detection is claimed — the rule simply refuses double payment, so k identities must field k genuinely distinct, full-cost answers or forfeit bonds. Seams: paraphrase or one-effort variants below threshold; colluding graders risk stake.
